user.title: SSD IMS Configuration
user.description: Enter your portal credentials for SSD IMS to gain access to your energy consumption data.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with SSD IMS
reauth_confirm.description: Your credentials for {username} are no longer valid. Please enter your current password to restore the connection.

point_of_delivery.title: Select Points of Delivery
point_of_delivery.description: Choose which Points of Delivery to monitor. Each is identified by its EIC code, the 16-character code printed on your invoice.

pod_naming.title: Configure POD Names
pod_naming.description:
Set friendly names for your Points of Delivery. This will be the visible name in Home Assistant - for example, your home address, apartment name, or location description.

{pod_info}

history_import.title: Data Import & Refresh
history_import.description: Configure how often the integration checks for new data and optionally import historical energy data into Home Assistant's statistics database for use in the Energy dashboard.

data.enable_history_import: Enable import of historical energy data

data_description.scan_interval: How often to check for new energy data. Since data is typically available once per day, frequent updates are not necessary.

init.title: SSD IMS Options
init.description: Update integration settings. Optional VT/NT prices are final prices in EUR per kWh incl. VAT, as printed on your supplier invoice (SSE: "Aktuálne koncové ceny elektriny platné pre Vašu sadzbu"). They are used to import hourly costs for the actual consumption statistic and monthly costs for the tariff register readings. For a single-rate tariff (D1/D2) fill in VT only; leave both empty to skip costs.

data_description.price_vt: Final price in EUR per kWh including VAT and all per-kWh fees, e.g. from your supplier invoice.
data_description.price_nt: Final price in EUR per kWh including VAT and all per-kWh fees, e.g. from your supplier invoice. Leave empty for single-rate tariffs (D1/D2) — the VT price is then used for all consumption.
